articles.title: Suspicious powder packages target lawmakers across party lines ahead of elections
articles.description: At least 20 members of Congress and several state lawmakers reported receiving suspicious packages with unknown powdery substances at their offices, triggering evacuations and federal investigations weeks before the midterm elections. Unlike previous mailings…
